Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results for Henry Roth. The search results explicitly stated that Henry Roth was born in Tysmenitz, Galicia, Austria-Hungary (now Ukraine) and was a Jewish immigrant to America. While the snippets used the phrase "English writer," this was likely a misclassification by the search engine or a confusing phrasing referring to his later life or style, but the biographical facts (birthplace in Eastern Europe, move to the US) clearly indicate he was not from England. The Planner accepted this contradictory information as fact ("Henry Roth was identified as an English writer") and failed to verify the birthplace details against the nationality claim, leading to the wrong conclusion that Henry Roth was from England over Robert Erskine Childers, who was explicitly described as "English-born" and born in London.
